 Big Blue Bus Offers Free on General Election Day
 October 19, 2026 12:15 PM 
 by Danielle Roman 
 Big Blue Bus is making it easier 
for community members to get to the polls by offering FREE rides system-wide on 
 Tuesday, November 3, 2026, for General Election Day . 
 As part of its commitment to 
connecting riders to essential destinations, Big Blue Bus is proud to help 
voters travel safely, conveniently, and affordably to cast their ballots. 
 Visit bigbluebus.com to quickly and easily plan your free trip!  
For additional help planning your trip to the polls, please call Customer 
Service at (310) 451-5444. 
 Authored By
 Danielle Roman
 Community Engagement Administrator
